title: HM Hospitales
overview: A patient experience redesign for HM Hospitales — Spain's leading private hospital network — focused on reducing anxiety through better digital communication before, during, and after medical procedures.

sections.label: Challenge
sections.content: Patients reported high anxiety levels due to unclear pre-procedure communication and a confusing patient portal. HM Hospitales needed a human-centred approach to redesign the digital patient journey.

sections.caption: Patient journey mapping — with medical staff and patients

sections.label: Research
sections.content: Conducted 18 in-depth interviews with patients and 12 with medical staff. Mapped the full patient journey from appointment booking to post-discharge. Identified 6 critical friction points causing anxiety and drop-off.

sections.label: Outcome
sections.content: The redesigned pre-procedure communication flow reduced reported patient anxiety by 34% in validation testing. The prototype was delivered to development teams with a full handoff spec and prototype library.
